name: NGC 1426 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1426, an elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1426-hubble
story: NGC 1426 is a smooth elliptical galaxy in a sparsely populated stretch of space. It is attended by a swarm of globular star clusters that fall into two distinct populations.

claims.text: NGC 1426 is an E4 elliptical galaxy
NGC 1426 is type E4, in a low-density field sample
Program targets are low-luminosity ellipticals in low-density environments
Its globular cluster system has a strongly bimodal color distribution
